sections.title: Daniel and the three youths in the land of Babylon.

verses.text: የይሁዳ ንጉሥ ኢዮአቄም በነገሠ በሦስተኛው ዓመት የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ናቡከደነፆር ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም መጥቶ ከበባት።
እግዚአብሔርም የይሁዳን ንጉሥ ኢዮአቄምን፥ ከእግዚአብሔርም ቤት ዕቃ ከፍሎ በእጁ አሳልፎ ሰጠው፤ እርሱም ወደ ሰናዖር ምድር ወደ ጣዖቱ ቤት ወሰደው፥ ዕቃውንም ወደ ጣዖቱ ግምጃ ቤት አገባው።
ንጉሡም ለጃንደረቦቹ አለቃ ለአስፋኒዝ፦ ከተማረኩት ከእስራኤል ልጆች ከነገሥታቱና ከመሳፍንቱ ዘር፥
ነውር የሌለባቸውንና መልከ መልካሞቹን፥ በጥበብ ሁሉ የሚያስተውሉትን፥ ዕውቀትም የሞላባቸውን፥ አስተዋዮች የሆኑትን፥ በንጉሡም ቤት መቆም የሚችሉትን ብላቴኖች ያመጣና የከለዳውያንንም ትምህርትና ቋንቋ ያስተምሩአቸው ዘንድ ነገረው።
ንጉሡም ሦስት ዓመት ያሳድጉአቸው ዘንድ፥ ከዚያም በኋላ በንጉሡ ፊት ይቆሙ ዘንድ ከንጉሡ ማዕድ፥ ከሚጠጣውም ጠጅ በየዕለቱ ድርጎአቸውን አዘዘላቸው።
ከእነዚህም መካከል ከይሁዳ ልጆች ዳንኤልና አናንያ ሚሳኤልና አዛርያ ነበሩ።
የጃንደረቦቹም አለቃ ስማቸውን ለውጦ፤ ዳንኤልን ብልጣሶር፥ አናንያንም ሲድራቅ፥ ሚሳኤልንም ሚሳቅ፥ አዛርያንም አብደናጎ ብሎ ጠራቸው።
ዳንኤልም ከንጉሡ ማዕድ እንዳይበላ፥ ከሚጠጣውም ጠጅ እንዳይጠጣ በልቡ ጨከነ፤ እንዳያበላውም የጃንደረቦቹን አለቃ ለመነው።
እግዚአብሔርም በጃንደረቦቹ አለቃ ፊት ለዳንኤል ሞገስንና ምሕረትን ሰጠው።
የጃንደረቦቹም አለቃ ዳንኤልን፥ “መብሉንና መጠጡን ያዘዘላችሁን ጌታዬን ንጉሡን እፈራለሁ፤ በዕድሜ እንደ እናንተ ከአሉ ብላቴኖች ይልቅ ፊታችሁ ከስቶ ያየ እንደ ሆነ፥ ከንጉሡ ዘንድ በራሴ ታስፈርዱብኛላችሁ” አለው።
And the chief of the eunuchs spoke to Daniel and to Hananiah, to Mishael and to Azariah, concerning the matter which he had commanded.
"Test your servants for ten days; and let them give us vegetables to eat and water to drink;
then let our appearance be examined before you, and the appearance of the young men who eat the king's delicacies; and as you see fit, so deal with your servants."
So he listened to them in this matter, and tested them for ten days.
And at the end of ten days, their countenance appeared fairer and fatter in flesh than all the young men who ate the king's delicacies.
Thus Melzar took away the portion of their meat and the wine that they should drink, and gave them vegetables.
And for these four young men, God gave them knowledge and skill in all learning and wisdom; and Daniel had understanding in all visions and dreams.
Now at the end of the days that the king had said he should bring them in, the chief of the eunuchs brought them in before Nebuchadnezzar.
And the king communed with them; and among them all was found none like Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah; therefore stood they before the king.
And in all matters of wisdom and understanding that the king inquired of them, he found them ten times better than all the magicians and astrologers that were in all his realm.
And Daniel remained until the first year of King Cyrus of Persia.

sections.title: The dream of Nebuchadnezzar.

verses.text: ናቡከደነፆርም በነገሠ በሁለተኛው ዓመት ሕልም አለመ፤ መንፈሱም ታወከ፤ ሕልሙንም ዘነጋው።
ንጉሡም ሕልሙን እንዲነግሩት የሕልም ተርጓሚዎቹንና አስማተኞቹን፥ መተተኞቹንና ከለዳውያኑንም ይጠሩ ዘንድ አዘዘ፤ እነርሱም ገብተው በንጉሡ ፊት ቆሙ።
ንጉሡም፥ “ሕልም አልሜአለሁ፤ መንፈሴም ታወከብኝ፤ ሕልሜንም ዘነጋሁት” አላቸው።
ከለዳውያኑም ንጉሡን በሱርስት ቋንቋ፥ “ንጉሥ ሆይ! ለዘለዓለም ኑር፤ ለአገልጋዮችህ ሕልምህን ንገር፤ እኛም ፍቺውን እንነግርሃለን” ብለው ተናገሩት።
ንጉሡም መለሰ፤ ከለዳውያኑንም፥ “ነገሩ ከእኔ ዘንድ ርቆአል፤ ሕልሙንና ፍቺውን ባታስታውቁኝ፥ ትገደላላችሁ፤ ቤቶቻችሁም የጉድፍ መጣያ ይደረጋሉ።
ሕልሙንና ፍቺውን ግን ብትነግሩኝ፥ ከእኔ ዘንድ ስጦታና ዋጋ፥ ብዙ ክብርም ትቀበላላችሁ፤ ስለዚህም ሕልሙንና ፍቺውን ንገሩኝ” አላቸው።
ሁለተኛም ጊዜ መልሰው፥ “ንጉሡ ለአገልጋዮቹ ሕልሙን ይንገር፥ እኛም ፍቺውን እንናገራለን” አሉት።
ንጉሡም መልሶ፥ “ነገሩ ከእኔ ዘንድ እንደ ራቀ ታውቃላችሁና ጊዜውን እንደምታስረዝሙ እኔ አውቃለሁ።
ሕልሙንም አሁን ባትነግሩኝ አንድ ፍርድ አለባችሁ፥ ጊዜውን ለማሳለፍ የሐሰትንና የተንኰልን ቃል ልትነግሩኝ አዘጋጅታችኋል፤ ስለዚህ ሕልሙን ንገሩኝ፤ ፍቺውንም መናገር እንደምትችሉ አውቃለሁ።”
ከለዳውያኑም በንጉሡ ፊት መልሰው፥ “የንጉሡን ነገር ያሳይ ዘንድ የሚችል ሰው በምድር ላይ የለም፤ ታላቅ ንጉሥና አለቃ የሆነ እንደዚያ ያለ ነገር የሕልም ተርጓሚንና አስማተኛን፥ ከለዳዊንም የሚጠይቅ የለም።
ንጉሡም የሚጠይቀው ነገር ከባድ ነው፤ መኖሪያቸው ከሥጋ ለባሽ ጋር ካልሆነ ከአማልክት በቀር በንጉሡ ፊት የሚያሳየው ማንም የለም” አሉ።
ያንጊዜ ንጉሡ ፈጽሞ ተቈጣ፤ የባቢሎንንም ጠቢባን ሁሉ ያጠፉ ዘንድ አዘዘ።
ከንጉሡም ዘንድ ትእዛዝ ወጣ፤ ጠቢባንንም ይገድሉ ዘንድ ጀመሩ፤ ዳንኤልንና ባልንጀሮቹንም ይገድሉአቸው ዘንድ ፈለጉአቸው።
የዚያን ጊዜም ዳንኤል የባቢሎንን ጠቢባን ይገድል ዘንድ የወጣውን የንጉሡን የዘብ አለቃ አርዮክን በፈሊጥና በማስተዋል ተናገረው፤
የንጉሡ የዘብ አለቃ አርዮክን፥ “ይህ ጭንቅ ትእዛዝ ከንጉሡ ዘንድ ስለ ምን ወጣ?” ብሎ ጠየቀው፤ አርዮክም ነገሩን ለዳንኤል ነገረው።
ዳንኤልም ገብቶ ፍቺውን ለንጉሡ የሚያስታውቅበት ጊዜ ይሰጠው ዘንድ ንጉሡን ለመነ።
የዚያን ጊዜም ዳንኤል ወደ ቤቱ ገባ። ነገሩንም ለባልንጀሮቹ ለአናንያና ለሚሳኤል፥ ለአዛርያም አስታወቃቸው።
ዳንኤልና ባልንጀሮቹም ከቀሩት ከባቢሎን ጠቢባን ጋር እንዳይሞቱ ስለዚህ ምሥጢር ምሕረትን ከሰማይ አምላክ ለመኑ።
የዚያን ጊዜም ምሥጢሩ በሌሊት ራእይ ለዳንኤል ተገለጠለት። ዳንኤልም የሰማይ አምላክን አመሰገነ።
እንዲህም አለ፥ “ጥበብና ምክር፥ ኀይልም ለእርሱ ነውና የእግዚአብሔር ስም ከዘለዓለም እስከ ዘለዓለም ይመስገን።
እሱም ጊዜያትንና ዘመናትን ይለውጣል፤ ነገሥታትን ያስነሣል፤ ነገሥታትንም ይሽራል፤ ጥበብን ለጠቢባን፥ ዕውቀትንም ለአስተዋዮች ይሰጣል።
የጠለቀውንና የተሰወረውን ይገልጣል፤ በጨለማ ያለውን ያውቃል፤ ብርሃንም ከእርሱ ጋር አለ።
አንተ የአባቶቻችን ፈጣሪ! እውቀትንና ጥበብን ሰጥተኸኛልና፥ የለመንሁህንም ነግረኸኛልና፥ የንጉሡን ሕልም፥ ትርጓሜውንም ገልጠህልኛልና እገዛልሃለሁ፤ አመሰግንህምአለሁ።”

sections.title: Daniel interpreted the dream to the king as he had spoken.

verses.text: And after this, Daniel went in to the king of Babylon to speak to him, saying, "Do not destroy the wise men of Babylon; bring me in before the king, and I will declare the dream and its interpretation to him."
At that time, Ariok hastened to bring Daniel before the king, and said, "I have found a man among the exiles from Judah who will make known to the king the dream and its interpretation."
The king answered and said to Daniel, whose name was Belteshazzar, "Are you able to make known to me the dream that I have seen and its interpretation?"
Daniel answered in the presence of the king and said, "The secret which the king has demanded cannot be made known to the wise men, the enchanters, the magicians, and the astrologers."
But there is a God in heaven who reveals secrets, and He has made known to King Nebuchadnezzar what will be in the latter days. Your dream and the visions of your head upon your bed are these:
"O king! As you lay in bed, thoughts came into your mind about what would be after this; and he who reveals secrets has made known to you what will be."

"However, this secret is not revealed to me because of any wisdom that I have more than any living man, but in order that the interpretation may be made known to the king and that you may know the thoughts of your heart."
"O king! You saw, and behold, there was a great image. This image, mighty and of exceeding brightness, stood before you, and its appearance was frightening."
The head of this image was of fine gold, its chest and arms of silver, its belly and thighs of bronze,
Its legs of iron, its feet partly of iron and partly of clay.
I beheld a great stone, as it was hewn from the mountain, and its feet were of iron and clay; until the end it smote and crushed.

At that time, the iron and the clay, the brass and the silver, and the gold were broken together, and became like the chaff of the summer threshing floors; and the wind carried them away, and no place was found for them; and the stone that smote the image became a great mountain and filled the whole earth.
"This is your dream; and we will tell the interpretation thereof before the king."
O king! Thou art a king of kings; for the God of heaven hath given thee a kingdom, power, and strength, and glory.
And wheresoever the children of men dwell, the beasts of the field and the fowls of the heaven hath He given into thine hand, and hath made thee ruler over them all; thou art this head of gold.
And after thee shall arise another kingdom inferior to thee, and another third kingdom of brass, which shall bear rule over all the earth.
And the fourth kingdom shall be strong as iron; forasmuch as iron breaketh in pieces and subdueth all things; and as iron that breaketh all these, shall it break in pieces and bruise.

And the feet and toes of the image were part of potter's clay and part of iron; the kingdom shall be divided; but there shall be in it of the strength of the iron, forasmuch as thou sawest the iron mixed with miry clay.
And as the toes of the feet were part of iron, and part of clay, so the kingdom shall be partly strong, and partly broken.
And whereas thou sawest iron mixed with miry clay, they shall mingle themselves with the seed of men; but they shall not cleave one to another, even as iron is not mixed with clay.

In those days of kings, the God of heaven shall establish a kingdom that shall not be shaken forever; it shall not be given to another people; and all those kingdoms shall be crushed; they shall be destroyed; but His kingdom shall stand forever.

And the stone, without hands, shall be cut out of the mountain, and it shall break in pieces the iron and the brass, the clay and the silver, and the gold; and as you have seen, the great God hath made known to the king what shall come to pass hereafter; the dream is certain, and the interpretation thereof is sure.

sections.title: The king honored Daniel as he had esteemed him.

verses.text: የዚያን ጊዜም ንጉሡ ናቡከደነፆር በግምባሩ ተደፍቶ ለዳንኤል ሰገደለት። ፈጽሞም አከበረው፥ ገጸ በረከትም ሰጠው፤ መልካም መዓዛም ያቀርቡለት ዘንድ አዘዘ።
ንጉሡም ዳንኤልን፥ “ይህን ምሥጢር ትገልጥ ዘንድ ተችሎሃልና በእውነት አምላካችሁ የአማልክት አምላክ፥ የነገሥታትም ጌታ፥ ምሥጢርም ገላጭ ነው” ብሎ ተናገረው።
ንጉሡም ዳንኤልን ከፍ ከፍ አደረገው፤ ብዙም ታላቅ ስጦታ ሰጠው፤ በባቢሎንም አውራጃዎች ሁሉ ላይ ሾመው፤ በባቢሎንም ጠቢባን ሁሉ ላይ ዋነኛ አለቃ አደረገው።
ዳንኤልም ንጉሡን ለመነ፤ እርሱም ሲድራቅንና ሚሳቅን፥ አብደናጎንም በባቢሎን አውራጃ ሥራ ላይ ሾማቸው፤ ዳንኤል ግን በንጉሡ አደባባይ ነበረ።

sections.title: And thou shalt make a golden image, which shall stand before thee.

verses.text: ንጉሡ ናቡከደነፆር በነገሠ በዐሥራ ስምንተኛው ዓመት ቁመቱ ስድሳ ክንድ፥ ወርዱም ስድስት ክንድ የሆነ የወርቅ ምስል አሠራ፤ በባቢሎንም አውራጃ በዱራ ሜዳ አቆመው።
ንጉሡም ናቡከደነፆር መኳንንትንና ሹሞችን፥ አዛዦችንና አዛውንቶችን፥ በጅሮንዶችንና አማካሪዎችን፥ መጋቢዎችንም፥ አውራጃ ገዢዎችንም ሁሉ ይሰበስቡ ዘንድ፥ ንጉሡ ናቡከደነፆርም ላቆመው ምስል ምረቃ ይመጡ ዘንድ ላከ።
በዚያን ጊዜም መኳንንቱና ሹሞቹ፥ አዛዦቹና አዛውንቶቹ፥ በጅሮንዶቹና አማካሪዎቹ፥ መጋቢዎቹና አውራጃ ገዢዎቹ ሁሉ ንጉሡ ናቡከደነፆር ላቆመው ምስል ምረቃ ተሰበሰቡ፤ ናቡከደነፆርም ባቆመው ምስል ፊት ቆሙ።
አዋጅ ነጋሪውም እየጮኸ እንዲህ አለ፥ “ሕዝብና አሕዛብ፥ በልዩ ልዩ ቋንቋም የምትናገሩ ሆይ! ንጉሥ ይላችኋል፥
የመለከትንና የእንቢልታን፥ የመሰንቆንና የክራርን፥ የበገናንና የዋሽንትን፥ የዘፈንንም ሁሉ ድምፅ በሰማችሁ ጊዜ ወድቃችሁ ንጉሡ ናቡከደነፆር ላቆመው ለወርቁ ምስል ስገዱ፤
ወድቆም የማይሰግድ በዚያን ጊዜ በሚነድድ እሳት እቶን ውስጥ ይጣላል።”
ስለዚህ በዚያን ጊዜ አሕዛብ ሁሉ የመለከቱንና የእንቢልታውን፥ የመሰንቆውንና የክራሩን፥ የበገናውንና የዘፈኑንም ሁሉ ድምፅ በሰሙ ጊዜ፥ ወገኖችና አሕዛብ፥ በልዩ ልዩ ቋንቋም የሚናገሩ ሁሉ ወድቀው፤ ንጉሡ ናቡከደነፆር ላቆመው ለወርቅ ምስል ሰገዱ።

sections.title: The third day.

verses.text: At that time, the Chaldeans brought forth accusations against the Jews before the king, Nabuchadnezzar.
And they spoke thus: “O king, live forever!
O king! The sound of the horn, the flute, the harp, the psaltery, and the dulcimer, and all kinds of music, let all people fall down and worship the golden image,
And whoever does not fall down and worship shall be cast into the midst of a burning fiery furnace.”

Now, O king, the decree that you have made is that all nations shall serve the image of gold, and those who do not obey your command shall be cast into the fiery furnace; there are three men who are called Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, who do not regard your gods, nor do they worship the golden image you have set up.”
Then, at that time, Nebuchadnezzar was filled with rage; in his fury, he commanded that Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego be brought before him.
Nebuchadnezzar spoke and said to them, “Is it true, O Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, that you do not serve my gods, nor worship the golden image which I have set up?

Now if you are ready at the time you hear the sound of the horn, the flute, the harp, the psaltery, and the dulcimer, and all kinds of music, to fall down and worship the image which I have made, good! But if you do not worship, you shall be cast immediately into the midst of a burning fiery furnace; and who is the god that shall deliver you out of my hands?”
Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego answered and said to the king, “O Nebuchadnezzar, we are not careful to answer you in this matter.
O king! The God whom we serve is able to deliver us from the burning fiery furnace, and He will deliver us out of your hand, O king.”
"O King! If this be not so, let us not serve thy gods, nor worship the golden image which thou hast set up."

At that time, they were filled with wrath against Sidrach and Misach, and the countenance of their faces was changed; and they spoke, saying, "Let the fire be made seven times hotter than it was wont to be made."
And concerning Sidrach and Misach, they commanded that they should be cast into the burning fiery furnace, that the mighty men should throw them into the fire.
At that time, those men were bound in their coats, their hosen, and their hats, and their other garments, and were cast into the midst of the burning fiery furnace.
Therefore the king's commandment was urgent, and the furnace was exceeding hot; the flame of the fire slew those men that took up Sidrach, Misach, and Abednego.
And these three men, Sidrach, Misach, and Abednego, fell down bound into the midst of the burning fiery furnace.

sections.title: The Prayer of the Three Young Men

verses.text: And in the midst of the fire, they turned and praised the Lord, and they gave thanks unto Him.
Azariah stood and prayed, saying thus, and in the midst of the fire, he began to offer praise.
"Blessed be the God of our fathers, the Lord."
"In all that thou hast brought upon us, thou art righteous; for all thy works are true, and thy ways are just."
"And in all that thou hast done for us, thou hast executed true judgment."
"We have been forsaken by thee; we have been left desolate."
"May it be well with us."
"And all that thou hast brought upon us and all that thou hast done for us, thou hast done in true judgment."
"From thee, we have been delivered into the hand of our enemies, the sinners and the wicked."
"Even now, we do not open our mouths, for our shame is not upon us."
For Thy name's sake, complete Thy work and do not forsake us.
Let not Thy forgiveness be far from us.
As their seed is like the stars of heaven,
For our transgressions, may we be cast down in all the land today.
In this time, there is no leader; there is no prophet; there is no king;
but may our hearts be accepted in every way, and may we receive the spirit of peace;
like the goats and the lambs,
even now, with our perfect hearts, we shall follow Thee; we shall also fear Thee;
Do not forsake us; yet according to Thy mercy and Thy forgiveness, multiply Thy grace upon us,
and in Thy wonders, deliver us;
Let all who show your servants distress fear; let them tremble in all their standing; let their strength be diminished.
Thou art the Lord God alone.
Yet those who served the king did not forsake their duty; they were consumed by the fire, and they were cast into the furnace, and they were not harmed.
And it was said, "Lift up your eyes from the pit, for it is deep and wide."
The fire was returning and consuming all that was around the furnace, and it was burning fiercely.
And the angel of the Lord went forth with Ananiah and Azariah and Mishael, and he struck the fire that was in the furnace, and it was extinguished.
And the flames of the fire did not harm them, nor did they scorch their garments; they were not even singed, nor did they smell of smoke.
At that time, those three men all together praised with one voice; they gave thanks to the Lord in the midst of the fire, saying:
"Blessed be the Lord God of our fathers, may He be exalted and praised."
"May the holy name of His greatness be exalted and praised."
In the holy place where we give thanks, Thou art worthy of honor;
Upon the cherubim, Thou art exalted, O Thou who art worthy of honor;
In Thy majesty, Thou art worthy of honor, O Lord;
Above the heavens, Thou art the one we glorify;
All the creatures of the Lord give thanks unto God;
The heavens give thanks unto God;
The angels of the Lord give thanks unto God;
All the waters above the heavens give thanks unto God;
All the hosts of the Lord give thanks unto God;
The sun and the moon give thanks unto God;
The heavens and the stars give praise unto the Lord God;
The mountains and the hills give praise unto the Lord God;
All the winds give praise unto the Lord God;
The fire and the hail give praise unto the Lord God;
The day and the night give praise unto the Lord God;
The mountains and the valleys give praise unto the Lord God;
The cold and the frost give praise unto the Lord God;
The light and the darkness give praise unto the Lord God;
The beasts and the cattle give praise unto the Lord God;
The rain and the dew give praise unto the Lord God;
The lightning and the clouds give praise to the Lord;
The earth shall give praise to the Lord;
The mountains and the hills give praise to the Lord;
All that dwells upon the earth shall give praise to the Lord;
The creatures of the field give praise to the Lord;
The sea and the rivers give praise to the Lord;
The birds and all that move in the waters give praise to the Lord;
All the fowl that fly in the heavens give praise to the Lord;
The beasts and all living creatures give praise to the Lord;
The children of men give praise to the Lord;
እስራኤል እግዚአብሔርን ያመሰግኑታል፤
የጌታ ካህናት እግዚአብሔርን ያመሰግኑታል፤
የጌታ ባሪያዎች እግዚአብሔርን ያመሰግኑታል፤
መንፈስና የጻድቃን ነፍሳት እግዚአብሔርን ያመሰግኑታል፤
አናንያና አዛርያ፥ ሚሳኤልም እግዚአብሔርን ያመሰግኑታል፤
እግዚአብሔር ከሞትና ከሲኦል እጅ አድኖናልና፥ ከሚነድድም ከምድጃው እሳት አስጥሎናልና፥ ከነበልባሉም መካከል አውጥቶናልና፤ ለእግዚአብሔር ተገዙ፤ ስሙንም አመስግኑት፤ ቸር ነውና ምሕረቱም ለዘለዓለም ነውና።
የአማልክትን አምላክ እግዚአብሔርን የምትፈሩ ሁላችሁ እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኑት፤ ተገዙለት፤ አመስግኑትም፤ ቸርነቱ ለዘለዓለም ነውና።
ንጉሡ ናቡከደነፆርም ሲያመሰግኑ ሰምቶ ተደነቀ፤ ፈጥኖም ተነሣ፤ አማካሪዎቹንም፥ “ሦስት ሰዎች አስረን በእሳት ውስጥ ጥለን አልነበረምን?” ብሎ ተናገራቸው። እነርሱም፥ “ንጉሥ ሆይ! እውነት ነው” አሉት።
ንጉሡም፥ “እኔ የተፈቱ በእሳቱም መካከል የሚመላለሱ አራት ሰዎችን በዚያ አያለሁ፤ ምንም የነካቸው የለም፤ የአራተኛውም መልክ የእግዚአብሔርን ልጅ ይመስላል” አለ።
የዚያን ጊዜም ናቡከደነፆር ወደሚነድደው ወደ እሳቱ እቶን በር ቀርቦ፥ “እናንተ የልዑል አምላክ ባሪያዎች፥ ሲድራቅና ሚሳቅ፥ አብደናጎም፥ ኑ ውጡ” ብሎ ተናገራቸው። ሲድራቅና ሚሳቅ፥ አብደናጎም ከእሳቱ መካከል ወጡ።

And the leaders, the priests and the nobles, the commanders and the mighty men of the king, were gathered together, that the fire might not consume their bodies, and that their garments might not be torn, and that the smell of the fire might not pass over them.

And the king bowed before the Lord, and he returned and said, "He sent His angel, and I have no other god besides my God, that they may not worship Him, and they have given their bodies as a sacrifice to Him, and the word of the king which they have spoken, He has delivered His servants who have trusted in Him, the gods of Sidrak and Misak, and of Abdenago, let them be praised."

And I too say that there is no other god who can deliver in this way, and concerning the gods of Sidrak and Misak, and of Abdenago, the people and the nations that speak of their deeds in different tongues shall be scattered; their houses shall be laid waste, thus I have declared.

At that time, the king commanded that Sidrak, Misak, and Abdenago be thrown into the province of Babylon; he raised them up high; and he caused all the Jews who were in his kingdom to be gathered together.

sections.title: The Second Dream of Nebuchadnezzar

verses.text: From the king who is exalted, to all the nations and peoples that dwell upon the earth, in every distinct language and tongue that they speak, “Peace be unto you.”
The Most High God has done wonders before me; I shall declare His marvels and His might unto you, for I have loved Him.
How great are His wonders! And how mighty is His strength! His kingdom is an everlasting kingdom; and His dominion is from generation to generation.
“I, Nebuchadnezzar, was at ease in my house and flourishing in my palace.”
I had a dream that troubled me; and the visions upon my bed frightened me; and my thoughts troubled me greatly.
Therefore, in order that they might make known unto me the interpretation of my dream, I commanded that all the magicians of Babylon be brought before me.
At that time, the interpreters of dreams and the enchanters came in, and I told them my dream; but the interpretation I did not make known unto them.
Finally, the Spirit of the Holy God, like the name of my God, whose name is Belteshazzar, came before me; and I said unto him:
O Belteshazzar, chief of the magicians! The Spirit of the Holy God is in you, and there is no secret that troubles you; I have seen the vision of my dream, and its interpretation declare unto me.
Upon my bed, I saw a vision; and behold, in the midst of the earth, there stood a tree, and its height was great.
The tree was great; it was lofty; its height reached unto heaven; and its branches extended to all the earth.

The leaves thereof were fair; and its fruit was much; and all creatures did feed upon it; and under it the beasts of the field had their habitation, and the fowls of the air dwelt in its branches; and flesh was for all to eat from it.
"In my dream by night I beheld, and lo, a holy watcher came down from heaven."

With a loud voice he cried out and said: "Hew down the tree, and cut off its branches; shake off its leaves, and scatter its fruit; let the beasts get away from under it, and the fowls from its branches."

Nevertheless, leave the stump of its roots in the earth, even with a band of iron and brass, in the tender grass of the field; and let it be wet with the dew of heaven, and let his portion be with the beasts in the grass of the earth.
Let his heart be changed from man's, and let a beast's heart be given unto him; and let seven times pass over him.

The Most High God rules in the kingdom of men, and gives it to whomsoever He will, and sets up over it the basest of men. This matter is by the decree of the watchers, and the demand by the word of the holy ones; to the intent that the living may know that the Most High rules in the kingdom of men, and gives it to whomsoever He will, and sets up over it the basest of men.

I, the king, have seen this dream; now thou, O Belteshazzar, declare the interpretation thereof, forasmuch as all the wise men of my kingdom are not able to make known unto me the interpretation; but thou art able; for the spirit of the holy gods is in thee."

sections.title: Daniel interpreted the king's dream.

verses.text: At that time, Belteshazzar, who is called Daniel, pondered for about an hour; his thoughts troubled him. The king spoke and said, "Belteshazzar, do not let the dream or its interpretation trouble you." Belteshazzar answered and said, "My lord, may the dream be for those who hate you, and its interpretation for your enemies."
It was great and mighty, its height reached unto heaven, and its sight to the end of all the earth.
Its leaves were beautiful, and its fruit abundant; it was food for all. The beasts of the field found shade under it, and the birds of the heavens dwelt in its branches; all flesh was fed from it.
O king! You are a king of great power and strength; your greatness has grown and reaches to the heavens, and your dominion extends to the ends of the earth.

The king commanded that the tree be cut down and its branches be removed; nevertheless, let the stump of the tree remain in the earth, bound with a band of iron and bronze, in the tender grass of the field; and let it be wet with the dew of heaven, and let its portion be with the beasts in the grass of the earth until seven times pass over it.
O king! This is the decree of the Most High, which has come upon my lord the king.

That he may drive out men from their homes, and until he knows that the Most High rules in the kingdom of men, and gives it to whomever He wills, he shall be driven from men and his dwelling shall be with the beasts of the field; he shall be made to eat grass like oxen, and he shall be wet with the dew of heaven until seven times pass over him.
To say that the stump of the tree be left means that your kingdom shall remain yours until you know that the heavens do rule.
O king! Therefore, let my counsel be acceptable to you; break off your sins by righteousness, and your iniquities by showing mercy to the poor; perhaps there may be a lengthening of your prosperity.

sections.title: The dream has come to pass.

verses.text: ይህ ሁሉ በንጉሡ በናቡከደነፆር ላይ ደረሰ።
ከዐሥራ ሁለት ወር በኋላም በባቢሎን ቤተ መንግሥት ሰገነት ላይ ሲመላለስ፤
ንጉሡ፥ “ይህች እኔ በጕልበቴ ብርታት ለግርማዬ ክብር የመንግሥት መኖሪያ እንድትሆን ያሠራኋት ታላቂቱ ባቢሎን አይደለችምን?” ብሎ ተናገረ።
ቃሉም ገና በንጉሡ አፍ ሳለ ድምፅ ከሰማይ መጣና፥ “ንጉሥ ናቡከደነፆር ሆይ! መንግሥት ከአንተ ዘንድ ዐለፈች ተብሎ ለአንተ ተነግሮአል፤
ልዑሉም የሰዎችን መንግሥት እንዲገዛ፥ ለሚወድደውም እንዲሰጠው እስክታውቅ ድረስ ከሰዎች ተለይተህ ትሰደዳለህ፤ መኖሪያህም ከምድር አራዊት ጋር ይሆናል፤ እንደ በሬም ሣር ትበላለህ፤ ሰባት ዘመናትም ያልፉብሃል” አለው።
በዚያም ሰዓት ነገሩ በናቡከደነፆር ላይ ደረሰ፤ ጠጕሩም እንደ አንበሳ፥ ጥፍሩም እንደ ንስር እስኪረዝም ድረስ ከሰዎች ተለይቶ ተሰደደ፤ እንደ በሬም ሣር በላ፤ አካሉም በሰማይ ጠል ረሰረሰ።
ከእነዚያም ዘመናት በኋላ እኔ ናቡከደነፆር ዐይኔን ወደ ሰማይ አነሣሁ፤ አእምሮዬም ተመለሰልኝ፤ ልዑሉንም ባረክሁ፤ ለዘለዓለም የሚኖረውንም አመሰገንሁ፤ አከበርሁትም፤ ግዛቱ የዘለዓለም ግዛት ነውና፥ መንግሥቱም ለልጅ ልጅ ነውና።
በምድርም የሚኖሩ ሁሉ እንደ ኢምንት ይቈጠራሉ፤ በሰማይም ሠራዊት በምድርም ላይ በሚኖሩ መካከል እንደ ፈቃዱ ያደርጋል፤ እጁንም የሚቃወማት ወይም፥ “ምን ታደርጋለህ?” የሚለው የለም።
በዚያን ጊዜም አእምሮዬ ተመለሰልኝ፤ ወደ መንግሥቴም ክብር መጣሁ፤ ግርማዬና ውበቴም ወደ እኔ ተመለሰ፤ አማካሪዎችና መኳንንቶችም ፈለጉኝ፤ በመንግሥቴም ውስጥ ጸናሁ፤ ብዙም ክብር ተጨመረልኝ።
አሁንም እኔ ናቡከደነፆር የሰማይን ንጉሥ አመሰግነዋለሁ፤ ከፍ ከፍም አደርገዋለሁ፥ አከብረውማለሁ። ሥራው ሁሉ እውነት፥ መንገዱም ቀና ነውና፤ በትዕቢትም የሚሄዱትን ያዋርድ ዘንድ ይችላልና።

sections.title: As the offering of the firstborn is to the Lord.

verses.text: ንጉሡ ብልጣሶር ለሺህ መኳንንቱ ትልቅ ግብዣ አደረገ፤ ለሺሁም የወይን ጠጅ ያጠጣ ነበር።
ብልጣሶርም የወይን ጠጅ በጠጣ ጊዜ ንጉሡና መኳንንቱ፥ ሚስቶቹና ቁባቶቹ ይጠጡባቸው ዘንድ፥ “አባቴ ናቡከደነፆር በኢየሩሳሌም ከነበረው ቤተ መቅደስ ያመጣቸውን የወርቁንና የብሩን ዕቃዎች አምጡ” ብሎ አዘዘ።
ያን ጊዜም በኢየሩሳሌም ከነበረው ከእግዚአብሔር ቤተ መቅደስ የመጡትን የወርቁንና የብሩን ዕቃዎች አመጡ፤ ንጉሡና መኳንንቱም፥ ሚስቶቹና ቁባቶቹም ጠጡባቸው።
የወይን ጠጅም እየጠጡ ከወርቅና ከብር፥ ከናስና ከብረት፥ ከእንጨትና ከድንጋይ የተሠሩትን አማልክት አመሰገኑ።
በዚያም ሰዓት የሰው እጅ ጣት ወጥታ በንጉሡ ቤት በተለሰነው ግንብ ላይ በመቅረዙ አንጻር ጻፈች፤ ንጉሡም የሰው ጣት ስትጽፍ አየ።
ያን ጊዜም የንጉሡ ፊት ተለወጠ፤ ልቡም ታወከ፤ የወገቡም ጅማቶች ተፈቱ፤ ጕልበቶቹም ተብረከረኩ።
ንጉሡም አስማተኞቹንና ከለዳውያኑን፥ ቃላተኞቹንም ያገቡ ዘንድ በታላቅ ድምፅ ጮኸ፤ ንጉሡም የባቢሎንን ጠቢባን፥ “ይህን ጽሕፈት ያነበበ፥ ፍቺውንም የነገረኝ ሐምራዊ ግምጃ ይለብሳል፤ የወርቅም ማርዳ በአንገቱ አስርለታለሁ፤ በመንግሥቴም ላይ ሦስተኛ ገዥ አድርጌ እሾመዋለሁ” ብሎ ተናገረ።
የዚያን ጊዜም የንጉሡ ጠቢባን ሁሉ ገቡ፤ ነገር ግን ጽሕፈቱን ያነብቡ ዘንድ፥ ፍቺውንም ለንጉሡ ይነግሩ ዘንድ አልቻሉም።
ንጉሡም ብልጣሶር እጅግ ደነገጠ፤ ፊቱም ተለወጠበት፤ መኳንንቱም ተደናገጡ።
ንግሥቲቱም የንጉሡንና የመኳንንቱን ቃል ሰምታ ወደ ግብዣ ቤት ገባች፤ እንዲህም አለች፥ “ንጉሥ ሆይ! ለዘለዓለም ኑር፤ አሳብህ አያስቸግርህ፤ ፊትህም አይለወጥ።

The Holy Spirit of the Lord dwells in your kingdom; and in the days of your father, wisdom was found like that of the angels, and understanding, and knowledge was given to him; your father was the king, and he made you a chief of the interpreters of dreams and of the wise men, and he appointed you as the head of the magicians and the enchanters.

Good spirit, and knowledge, and understanding, and the interpretation of dreams, and the declaration of enigmas, and the solving of riddles have been found in him; and he is Daniel, whom the king named Belteshazzar. Now let him be called, and he will declare the interpretation to you.
At that time, Daniel came in before the king; and the king spoke and said to him, “Are you Daniel, who is one of the captives of Judah, whom my father the king brought from Judah?”
As the Holy Spirit of the Lord is with you, I have heard concerning you that you have knowledge and understanding, and the interpretation of dreams has been found in you.

Now, let those who read this writing come to me, and let the wise men and the astrologers, the Chaldeans and the diviners come to me; but they were not able to declare the interpretation of the writing to me.

But you, if you give the interpretation, and if you can solve the riddle, I have heard that you will be clothed with purple, and a chain of gold will be put around your neck, and you shall be the third ruler in the kingdom.

Then Daniel answered before the king, and said, “Let your gifts be for yourself, and give your rewards to another; nevertheless, I will read the writing to the king, and make known to him the interpretation.
O king! The Most High God gave your father, to Nebuchadnezzar, the kingdom and greatness, glory and majesty.

Because of the greatness that He gave him, all peoples, nations, and languages trembled and feared before him; whom he would, he killed; and whom he would, he kept alive; and whom he would, he set up; and whom he would, he put down.
But when his heart was lifted up, and his spirit was hardened so that he dealt proudly, he was deposed from his kingly throne, and his glory was taken from him.

The Most High God, that He might take the kingdom of men, and give it to whomsoever He will; until He knows, He was separated from the sons of men, and his heart was made like that of a beast; and his dwelling was with the wild donkeys; he did eat grass like oxen; and his body was wet with the dew of heaven.
O Belshazzar! Thou hast not humbled thy heart, though thou knewest all this; neither hast thou glorified the God of heaven.
In heaven, God hath numbered thy kingdom, and finished it; thou art weighed in the balances, and found wanting; thy kingdom is divided, and given to the Medes and Persians.
Therefore, this writing was sent forth from Him; and this writing is the interpretation thereof.
"The interpretation of the writing is: MENE, TEKEL, PERES."
This is the interpretation of the matter: MENE, God hath numbered thy kingdom, and finished it; TEKEL, thou art weighed in the balances, and art found wanting.
TEKEL means, thou art weighed in the balance, and art found wanting.
PERES means, thy kingdom is divided, and given to the Medes and Persians.
In that night, was Belshazzar the king of the Chaldeans slain; and Darius the Median took the kingdom, being about threescore and two years old.
And in that night, was the king of the Chaldeans slain.
And Darius the Median reigned in his stead. And his age was sixty-two years.

sections.title: The decree made concerning Daniel.

verses.text: And Darius appointed a hundred and twenty satraps to be over his kingdom, that they might be in authority.
And the satraps brought their accounts to him, that the king might not suffer any loss; and among them was Daniel, one of the three presidents.
Now Daniel had an excellent spirit within him, and the king thought to set him over the whole kingdom.

At that time, the presidents and the satraps sought to find occasion against Daniel concerning the kingdom; but they could find no occasion nor fault, for he was faithful, and no error or fault was found in him.
Then said those men, “We shall not find any occasion against this Daniel, unless we find it against him concerning the law of his God.”
Then these presidents and satraps assembled together to the king and said thus unto him, “King Darius, live forever!

All the presidents of the kingdom, the governors, and the satraps, the counselors, and the captains have consulted together to establish a royal statute and to make a firm decree, that whosoever shall ask a petition of any god or man for thirty days, save of thee, O king, he shall be cast into the den of lions.
Now, O king, establish the decree and sign the writing, that it be not changed, according to the law of the Medes and Persians, which altereth not.”
Wherefore King Darius signed the writing and the decree.

sections.title: Daniel was cast into the den of lions.

verses.text: Daniel, having received this decree, entered his house; and his windows were opened toward Jerusalem, as was his custom before, and three times a day he knelt down on his knees and prayed, giving thanks before his God, as he had done previously.
And those men watched him closely, and found him praying and making supplication before his God.

And they came near to the king, and spoke concerning the king's decree: "O king! Did you not sign a decree that for thirty days any man who petitions any god or man, except you, O king, shall be cast into the den of lions?" The king answered and said, "The thing is true, according to the law of the Medes and Persians, which does not alter."

Then they answered and said before the king, "That Daniel, who is one of the captives from Judah, does not show due regard for you, O king, or for the decree that you have signed, but makes his petition three times a day."
The king, when he heard these words, was greatly displeased with himself, and set his heart on Daniel to deliver him; and he labored till the going down of the sun to rescue him.
Then these men approached the king, and said to the king, "Know, O king, that it is the law of the Medes and Persians that no decree or statute which the king establishes may be changed."
So the king gave the command, and they brought Daniel and cast him into the den of lions. But the king spoke, saying to Daniel, "Your God, whom you serve continually, He will deliver you."
Then a stone was brought and laid on the mouth of the den, and the king sealed it with his own signet and with the signet of his lords, that the purpose concerning Daniel might not be changed.

Now the king went to his palace and spent the night fasting; and no musicians were brought before him. Also, his sleep went from him. And the king arose very early in the morning and went in haste to the den of lions.

sections.title: Daniel was as a lion from the mouth of the lions.

verses.text: And in the evening, the king arose in haste and went to the den of lions.

And as he drew near to the den, he cried out with a loud voice; the king spoke and said to Daniel, “O Daniel, servant of the living God! Is your God, whom you serve continually, able to deliver you from the lions?”
Daniel said to the king, “O king! Live forever.
My God has sent His angel and shut the lions' mouths, so that they have not hurt me, because I was found innocent before Him; and also, O king, I have done no wrong before you.”

Then the king was exceedingly glad for him, and commanded that they should take Daniel up out of the den. So Daniel was taken up out of the den, and no injury whatever was found on him, because he believed in his God.

And the king commanded, and they brought those men who had accused Daniel, and they cast them into the den of lions, them, their children, and their wives; and the lions overpowered them and broke all their bones in pieces before they ever came to the bottom of the den.
Then King Darius wrote to all peoples, nations, and languages that dwell in all the earth: “Peace be multiplied to you.

I make a decree that in every dominion of my kingdom, men must tremble and fear before the God of Daniel. For He is the living God, and steadfast forever; His kingdom is the one which shall not be destroyed, and His dominion shall endure to the end.
He delivers and rescues, and He works signs and wonders in heaven and on earth, who has delivered Daniel from the power of the lions.”
So this Daniel prospered in the reign of Darius and in the reign of Cyrus the Persian.

sections.title: Concerning the Four Living Creatures

verses.text: በባቢሎን ንጉሥ በብልጣሶር በመጀመሪያው ዓመተ መንግሥት ዳንኤል በአልጋው ላይ ሕልምንና የራሱን ራእይ አየ፤ ከዚያም በኋላ ሕልሙን ጻፈ፥
እንዲህም አለ፥ “እኔ ዳንኤል ራእይ አየሁ፤ እነሆም አራቱ የሰማይ ነፋሳት በታላቁ ባሕር ላይ ይነፍሱ ነበር።
አራትም ታላላቅ አራዊት ከባሕር ወጡ፥ እያንዳንዲቱም ከሌላይቱ ልዩ ነበረች።
መጀመሪያይቱ እንደ ሴት አንበሳ ነበረች፤ እንደ ንስርም ክንፍ ነበራት፤ ክንፎችዋም ከእርስዋ እስኪነቀሉ ድረስ አይ ነበር፤ ከምድርም ከፍ ከፍ አለች፤ እንደ ሰውም በእግር ቆመች፤ የሰውም ልብ ተሰጣት።
እነሆም ሁለተኛይቱ ድብ የምትመስል ሌላ አውሬ ነበረች፤ በአንድ ወገንም ቆመች፤ ሦስትም የጎድን አጥንቶች በአፍዋ ውስጥ በጥርሶችዋ መካከል ነበሩ፤ እንደዚህም፦ ተነሥተሽ እጅግ ሥጋ ብዪ አሏት።
ከዚህም በኋላ፥ እነሆ ነብር የምትመስል፥ በጀርባዋም ላይ አራት የወፍ ክንፎች የነበሩአት፤ ሌላ አውሬ አየሁ፤ ለአውሬይቱም አራት ራሶች ነበሩአት፤ ሥልጣንም ተሰጣት።
ከዚህም በኋላ በሌሊት ራእይ አየሁ፤ እነሆም የምታስፈራና የምታስደነግጥ፥ እጅግም የበረታች፥ ታላላቅም የብረት ጥርሶች የነበሩአት አራተኛ አውሬ ነበረች፤ ትበላና ታደቅቅ ነበር፥ የቀረውንም በእግርዋ ትረግጥ ነበር፤ ከእርስዋም በፊት ከነበሩት አራዊት ሁሉ የተለየች ነበረች፤ ዐሥር ቀንዶችም ነበሩአት።
ቀንዶችንም ተመለከትሁ፤ እነሆም፤ በመካከላቸው ሌላ ትንሽ ቀንድ ወጣ፤ በፊቱም ከቀደሙት ቀንዶች ሦስት ተነቃቀሉ፤ እነሆም በዚያ በትንሹ ቀንድ እንደ ሰው ዐይኖች የነበሩ ዐይኖች፥ በትዕቢትም የሚናገር አፍ ነበሩበት።
“ዙፋኖችም እስኪዘረጉ ድረስ አየሁ፤ በዘመናት የሸመገለውም ተቀመጠ፤ ልብሱም እንደ በረዶ ነጭ፥ የራሱም ጠጕር እንደ ነጭ ሱፍ ነበረ፤ ዙፋኑም የእሳት ነበልባል ነበረ፥ መንኰራኵሮቹም የሚነድድ እሳት ነበሩ።
የእሳትም ፈሳሽ ከፊቱ ይፈልቅና ይወጣ ነበር፤ ሺህ ጊዜ ሺህ የሆኑ ያገለግሉት ነበር፤ እልፍ አእላፋትም በፊቱ ቆመው ነበር፤ ለፍርድም ተቀመጠ፤ መጻሕፍትንም ገለጠ።
In that time, this beast arose from the matter that was spoken, and I beheld until it was slain and its body was destroyed; and it was given to be burned with fire.
And from the remaining beasts, their dominion was taken away; yet their lives were prolonged for a season and a time.
"And in the night I beheld a vision; and behold, there came with the clouds of heaven one like unto the Son of man, and he came to the Ancient of days, and they brought him near before him."

And nations and peoples, speaking in diverse tongues, shall serve him; dominion and glory shall be given to him; and a kingdom that shall not be destroyed is his dominion, and a kingdom that shall not pass away is his reign.

sections.title: The vision of the dream.

verses.text: "And I, Daniel, was troubled in spirit, and the visions of my head troubled me greatly."
"Then I approached one of those who stood by and asked him the truth concerning all this; and he told me and made known to me the interpretation of the things."

"Thus he said: 'These four great beasts, which you saw, are four kings that shall arise out of the earth; but the saints of the Most High shall receive the kingdom and possess the kingdom forever, even forever and ever.'"
"But the kingdom shall be given to the saints of the Most High; His saints shall possess the kingdom; and the kingdom shall be given to them until the end of the age."
"After this, as for the rest of the beasts, they were stripped of their dominion, but their lives were prolonged for a season and a time."

"And concerning the ten horns that were on its head, and the other horn which came up, before which three fell, and that horn had eyes and a mouth speaking pompous words, whose appearance was greater than his fellows, I was watching; and the same horn was making war against the saints and prevailing against them."
"Indeed, I watched, and that horn was making war with the saints and prevailing against them."
"Until the Ancient of Days came, and a judgment was made in favor of the saints of the Most High; and the time came for the saints to possess the kingdom."
"Thus he said: 'The fourth beast shall be a fourth kingdom on earth, which shall be different from all other kingdoms; and it shall devour the whole earth, trample it down, and break it in pieces.'"
"The ten horns are ten kings who shall arise from this kingdom; and another shall rise after them; he shall be different from the first ones, and shall subdue three kings."

He shall speak His word upon the exalted; He shall gather together the saints of the exalted; He shall consider the times and change the law, until the time and until the ages, until the fullness of time shall be given into His hand.
Nevertheless, judgment shall come; until the end of the matter, they shall be judged and their transgressions shall be removed, and their dominion shall be taken away from them.

The kingdom and the dominion, all that is beneath the heavens, shall be given to the great ones of the exalted holy people; the kingdom is the everlasting kingdom; all rulers shall serve Him; they shall be subject to Him.
The matter concerning them is until this time. And I, Daniel, was greatly troubled in my spirit; my countenance was changed, but I kept the matter in my heart.

sections.title: Daniel saw a vision of a great beast.

verses.text: በመጀመሪያ ከተገለጠልኝ ራእይ በኋላ፥ ንጉሡ ብልጣሶር በነገሠ በሦስተኛው ዓመት ለእኔ ለዳንኤል ራእይ ተገለጠልኝ፤
በኤላም አውራጃ በአለው በሱሳ ግንብ ሳለሁ ራእይ አየሁ፤ በኡባልም ወንዝ አጠገብ ነበርሁ።
ዐይኖችንም አቅንቼ አየሁ፤ እነሆም አንድ የበግ አውራ መጥቶ በኡባል አጠገብ ቆመ፤ ሁለት ቀንዶች ነበሩት፤ ቀንዶቹም ረዣዥሞች ነበሩ፤ አንዱ ቀንዱ ግን ከሌላው ቀንዱ ይበልጥ ነበር፤ ረዥሙም ቀንዱ በስተኋላ የበቀለ ነበር።
አውራውም በግ ወደ ምዕራብ፥ ወደ ሰሜንም፥ ወደ ደቡብም በቅንዱ ሲጐሽም አየሁ፤ አራዊትም ሁሉ በፊቱ አይቆሙም ነበር፤ ከእጁም የሚያድን አልነበረም፤ እንደ ፈቃዱም አደረገ፤ ከፍ ከፍም አለ።
እኔ ዳንኤልም የባሪ ክፍል በምትሆን በሱሳ ነበርሁ፤ ስመለከትም እነሆ ከምዕራብ ወገን አንድ አውራ ፍየል በምድር ሁሉ ፊት ላይ ወጣ፤ ምድርንም አልነካም፤ ለፍየሉም በዐይኖቹ መካከል አንድ ታላቅ ቀንድ ነበረው።
ሁለትም ቀንድ ወደ አለው፥ በኡባል ወንዝም ፊት ቆሞ ወደ አየሁት አውራ በግ መጣ፤ በኀይሉም ቍጣ ፈጥኖ ወደ እርሱ ሮጠ።
ወደ አውራውም በግ ቀርቦ አየሁት፤ እርሱም ዘልሎ ወጣበት፤ አውራውንም በግ መታ፤ ሁለቱንም ቀንዶች ሰበረ፤ አውራውም በግ በፊቱ ሊቆም ኀይል አልነበረውም፤ እርሱም በምድር ላይ ጥሎ ረገጠው፤ አውራውንም በግ ከእጁ ያድን ዘንድ የሚችል አልነበረም።
አውራውም ፍየል ራሱን እጅግ ታላቅ አደረገ፤ በበረታም ጊዜ ታላቁ ቀንዱ ተሰበረ፤ ወደ አራቱም የሰማይ ነፋሳት የሚመለከቱ አራት ቀንዶች ከበታቹ ወጡ።
ከእነርሱም ከአንደኛው አንድ ጠንካራ ቀንድ ወጣ፤ ወደ ደቡብም፥ ወደ ምሥራቅም፥ ወደ መልካሚቱም ምድር እጅግ ከፍ አለ።
እስከ ሰማይም ሠራዊት ድረስ ከፍ አለ፤ ከሰማይ ሠራዊትና ከሰማይ ከዋክብትም የተወሰኑትን ወደ ምድር ጣለ፥ ረገጣቸውም።
እስከ ሠራዊትም አለቃ ድረስ ምርኮን አዳነ፤ ከእርሱም የተነሣ የዘወትሩ መሥዋዕት ተሻረ፤ የመቅደሱም ስፍራ ፈረሰ።
የኀጢአትም መሥዋዕት ከዘወትሩ መሥዋዕት ጋር ተሰጠ፤ እውነትም ወደ ምድር ተጣለች፤ አደረገም፤ ተከናወነም።
ከቅዱሳኑም አንዱ ሲናገር ሰማሁ፤ ለተናገረው ለቅዱሱም ሁለተኛው ቅዱስ “ስለ ዘወትሩ መሥዋዕት፥ መቅደሱና ሠራዊቱም ይረገጡ ዘንድ ስለሚሰጥና ስለሚያጠፋ ኀጢአት የሆነው ይህ ራእይ እስከ መቼ ይቈያል?” አለው።
እርሱም፥ “እስከ ሁለት ሺህ ሦስት መቶ ማታና ጥዋት ድረስ ነው፤ ከዚያም በኋላ መቅደሱ ይነጻል” አለኝ።

sections.title: The holy angel Gabriel revealed the vision unto Daniel as it had been interpreted.

verses.text: I, Daniel, sought to understand the vision that I had seen; and behold, there stood before me one like the appearance of a man.
In the midst of the river Ulai, I heard the voice of a man; and he called and said, "Gabriel, make this man understand the vision."
So I came near where I stood; and when he came, I was frightened and fell upon my face; but he said unto me, "O son of man, understand that the vision is for the time of the end."
While he was speaking with me, I fell into a deep sleep on my face toward the ground; but he touched me and set me upright.
And he said unto me, "Behold, I will make known to you what shall be in the latter time of the indignation; for at the appointed time, the end shall be."
The vision that you saw, the ram which had two horns, is the king of Media and Persia.
And the rough goat is the king of Greece; and the great horn that is between his eyes is the first king.
And as for the broken horn, and the four that stood up in its place, four kingdoms shall arise out of that nation, but not in his power.
And in the latter time of their kingdom, when the transgressors are come to the full, a king of fierce countenance shall stand up, and understanding dark sentences shall stand.
And his power shall be mighty, but not by his own power; and he shall destroy wonderfully, and shall prosper and practice, and shall destroy the mighty and the holy people.

He shall cause the day to be darkened; there is a snare in His hand; in His heart, it shall be hidden; He shall destroy many with a pestilence; He shall stand upon the leaders; even without a hand, He shall gather.
And that which was spoken is indeed the vision of the night and of the dawn; however, it shall be delayed for many generations, so keep the vision.
And I, Daniel, slept; I was troubled in the night; then afterward, I arose to perform the work of the king; for I was troubled by the vision; yet the understanding was not given to me.

sections.title: The Prayer of Daniel

verses.text: በከለዳውያን መንግሥት ላይ በነገሠ፥ ከሜዶን ዘር በነበረ በአሕሻዊሮስ ልጅ በዳርዮስ በመጀመሪያው ዓመት፥
በነገሠ በመጀመሪያው ዓመት እኔ ዳንኤል በሰባ ዓመት የኢየሩሳሌም ጥፋት እንደሚፈጸም እግዚአብሔር በነቢዩ ኤርምያስ የተናገረው ቃል በተጻፈበት መጽሐፍ ያለውን የዘመኑን ቍጥር ዐወቅሁ።
ማቅ ለብሼ፥ በአመድም ላይ ሆኜ ስጾም እጸልይና እለምን ዘንድ ፊቴን ወደ ጌታ ወደ አምላክ አቀናሁ።
ወደ አምላኬም ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጸለይሁ፤ ተናዝዤም እንዲህ አልሁ፥ “ጌታ ሆይ! ከሚወድዱህና ትእዛዝህን ከሚፈጽሙ ጋር ቃል ኪዳንንና ምሕረትን የምትጠብቅ ታላቅና የምታስፈራ አምላክ ሆይ!
ኀጢአትን ሠርተናል፥ በድለንማል፤ ክፋትንም አድርገናል፤ ዐምፀንማል፤ ከትእዛዝህና ከፍርድህም ፈቀቅ ብለናል፤
በስምህም ለነገሥታቶቻችንና ለአለቆቻችን፥ ለአባቶቻችንም፥ ለሀገሩም ሕዝብ ሁሉ የተናገሩትን ባሪያዎችህን ነቢያትን አልሰማንም።
ጌታ ሆይ! ጽድቅ ለአንተ ነው፤ እንደ ዛሬም ለእኛ ለይሁዳ ሰዎችና በኢየሩሳሌም ለሚቀመጡ፥ ለእስራኤልም ሁሉ በቅርብና በሩቅም ላሉት አንተን በበደሉበት በበደላቸው ምክንያት በበተንህበት ሀገር ሁሉ የፊት እፍረት ነው።
ጌታ ሆይ! በአንተ ላይ ኀጢአት ስለ ሠራን ለእኛና ለነገሥታቶቻችን፥ ለአለቆቻችንና ለአባቶቻችንም የፊት እፍረት ነው።
ለጌታ ለአምላካችን ምሕረትና ይቅርታ ነው፤ በእርሱ ላይ ዐምፀናልና።
በባሪያዎቹም በነቢያት እጅ በፊታችን በአኖረው በሕጉ እንሄድ ዘንድ የአምላካችንን የግዚአብሔርን ቃል አልሰማንምና።
እስራኤልም ሁሉ ሕግህን ተላልፈዋል፤ ቃልህንም መስማትን እንቢ ብለዋል፤ በእርሱ ላይ ኀጢአት ሠርተናልና መርገምና በእግዚአብሔር ባሪያ በሙሴ ሕግ የተጻፈው መሐላ መጣብን።
እጅግ ክፉ ነገርንም በእኛ ላይ በማምጣቱ በላያችንና በእኛ ዘንድ በተሾሙት ፈራጆቻችን ላይ የተናገረውን ቃል አጸና፤ በኢየሩሳሌምም ላይ እንደ ተደረገው ያለ ነገር ከቶ ከሰማይ ሁሉ በታች አልተደረገም።
በሙሴም ሕግ እንደ ተጻፈ ይህ ክፉ ነገር ሁሉ መጣብን፤ ከኀጢአታችን እንመለስ፤ እውነትህንም እናስብ ዘንድ ወደ አምላካችን ወደ እግዚአብሔር ፊት አልለመንንም።
ስለዚህም እግዚአብሔር ክፉ ነገርን በእኛ ላይ ፈጥኖ አመጣ፤ አምላካችን እግዚአብሔር በሚሠራው ሥራ ሁሉ ጻድቅ ነውና፤ እኛም ቃሉን አልሰማንምና።
አሁንም ሕዝብህን ከግብፅ ምድር በበረታች እጅ ያወጣህ፥ እንደ ዛሬም ቀን ስምን ለአንተ ያደረግህ ጌታ አምላካችን ሆይ! ኀጢአትን ሠርተናል፤ ክፋትንም አድርገናል።
ጌታ ሆይ! በፍጹም ቸርነትህ ቍጣህንና መቅሠፍትህን ከከተማህ ከኢየሩሳሌምና ከተቀደሰው ተራራህ መልስ፤ ስለ ኀጢአታችንና ስለ አባቶቻችን በደል ኢየሩሳሌምና ሕዝብህ በዙሪያችን ላሉት ሁሉ መሰደቢያ ሆነዋልና።
አሁንም አምላካችን ሆይ! የባሪያህን ጸሎትና ልመናውን ስማ፤ ጌታ ሆይ! በፈረሰው በመቅደስህ ላይ ስለ አንተ ስትል ፊትህን አብራ።
አምላኬ ሆይ! በፊትህ የምንለምን ስለ ብዙ ምሕረትህ ነው እንጂ ስለ ጽድቃችን አይደለምና ጆሮህን አዘንብለህ ስማ፤ ዐይንህንም ገልጠህ ጥፋታችንንና ስምህ የተጠራባትን ከተማ ተመልከት።
አቤቱ! ስማ፤ አቤቱ፥ ይቅር በል፤ አቤቱ! አድምጥና አድርግ፤ አምላኬ ሆይ! ስምህ በከተማህና በሕዝብህ ላይ ተጠርቶአልና ስለ ራስህ አትዘግይ።”
እኔም ገና ስናገርና ስጸልይ፥ በኀጢአቴና በሕዝቤም በእስራኤል ኀጢአት ስናዘዝ፥ በአምላኬም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ስለ ተቀደሰው ስለ አምላኬ ተራራ ይቅርታን ስጠይቅ፥
And while I was speaking in prayer, the man Gabriel, whom I had seen in the vision at the beginning, came to me in swift flight at the time of the evening sacrifice.
He instructed me and spoke to me, saying, “O Daniel! I have now come forth to give you skill and understanding.
You are greatly beloved; therefore, consider the matter and understand the vision.

“Seventy weeks are determined for your people and for your holy city, to finish the transgression, to make an end of sins, to make reconciliation for iniquity, to bring in everlasting righteousness, to seal up vision and prophecy, and to anoint the Most Holy.

Therefore, know and understand: From the going forth of the command to restore and build Jerusalem until the Messiah the Prince, there shall be seven weeks and sixty-two weeks; the street shall be built again, and the wall, even in troublesome times.

And after the sixty-two weeks, the Anointed One shall be cut off, but not for Himself; and the people of the prince who is to come shall destroy the city and the sanctuary. The end of it shall be with a flood, and till the end of the war desolations are determined.

Then he shall confirm a covenant with many for one week; but in the middle of the week he shall bring an end to sacrifice and offering. And on the wing of abominations shall be one who makes desolate, even until the consummation, which is determined, is poured out on the desolate.”

sections.title: Daniel saw a vision by the river Tigris.

verses.text: In the first year of King Cyrus, in the third year of his reign, a matter was revealed unto Daniel, whose name was called Belteshazzar; and the matter was true, but the time appointed was long; and he understood the matter, and had understanding of the vision.
In those days, I, Daniel, was mourning three full weeks.
I ate no pleasant bread, neither came flesh nor wine in my mouth, neither did I anoint myself at all, till three whole weeks were fulfilled.
In the first month, in the four and twentieth day of the month, as I was by the side of the great river, which is Hiddekel.
Then I lifted up mine eyes, and looked, and behold, a certain man clothed in linen, whose loins were girded with fine gold of Uphaz.

His body also was like the beryl, and his face as the appearance of lightning, and his eyes as lamps of fire, and his arms and his feet like in color to polished brass, and the voice of his words like the voice of a multitude.
And I, Daniel, alone saw the vision; for the men that were with me saw not the vision; but a great quaking fell upon them, so that they fled to hide themselves.
Therefore I was left alone, and saw this great vision, and there remained no strength in me; for my comeliness was turned in me into corruption, and I retained no strength.
Yet heard I the voice of his words: and when I heard the voice of his words, then was I in a deep sleep on my face, and my face toward the ground.
And, behold, an hand touched me, which set me upon my knees and upon the palms of my hands.
እርሱም፥ “እጅግ የተወደድህ ሰው ዳንኤል ሆይ! እኔ ዛሬ ወደ አንተ ተልኬአለሁና የምነግርህን ቃል አስተውል፤ ቀጥ ብለህም ቁም” አለኝ። ይህንም ቃል በአለኝ ጊዜ እየተንቀጠቀጥሁ ቆምሁ።
እርሱም እንዲህ አለኝ፥ “ዳንኤል ሆይ! አትፍራ፤ ልብህ ያስተውል ዘንድ፥ ሰውነትህም በአምላክህ ፊት ይዋረድ ዘንድ ከአደረግህበት ከመጀመሪያው ቀን ጀምሮ ቃልህ ተሰምቶአል፤ እኔም ስለ ቃልህ መጥቻለሁ።
የፋርስ መንግሥት አለቃ ግን ሃያ አንድ ቀን በፊቴ ቁሞ ነበር። እነሆም ከዋነኞቹ አለቆች አንዱ ሚካኤል ሊረዳኝ መጣ፤ እኔም ከፋርስ ንጉሥ ጋር በዚያ ተውሁት።
የራእዩም ጊዜ ገና ነውና በኋለኛው ዘመን ለሕዝብህ የሚሆነውን አስታውቅህ ዘንድ አሁን መጥቻለሁ።”
ይህንም ቃል በተናገረኝ ጊዜ ፊቴን ወደ ምድር ደፋሁ፤ ዲዳም ሆንሁ።
እነሆም የሰው ልጅ የሚመስል ከንፈሬን ዳሰሰኝ፤ ያን ጊዜም አፌን ከፍቼ ተናገርሁ፤ በፊቴም ቁሞ የነበረውን፥ “ጌታዬ ሆይ! ከራእዩ የተነሣ ሰውነቴ ታወከች፤ ኀይልም አጣሁ።
አቤቱ! አገልጋይህ ከጌታዬ ጋር ይናገር ዘንድ እንዴት ይችላል? ከአሁንም ጀምሮ ኀይሌ አይጸናም፤ እስትንፋስም አልቀረልኝም” አልሁት።
ደግሞ ሰው የሚመስል ዳሰሰኝ፤ አበረታኝም።
እርሱም፥ “እጅግ የተወደድህ ሰው ሆይ! አትፍራ፤ ሰላም ለአንተ ይሁን፤ በርታ፤ ጽና፥” አለኝ። በተናገረኝም ጊዜ በረታሁና፥ “አበርትተኸኛልና ጌታዬ ይናገር” አልሁ።
እርሱም እንዲህ አለኝ፥ “ወደ አንተ የመጣሁት ስለ ምን እንደ ሆነ፥ ታውቃለህን? አሁንም የፋርስን አለቃ እወጋው ዘንድ እመለሳለሁ፤ እኔም ስወጣ፥ እነሆ የግሪኮች አለቃ ይመጣል።
However, I shall speak to you of that which is written in truth; and in this matter, there is none who can assist me, save your leader, Michael.
"And I, in the first year of Darius the Mede, stood and was strengthened."

"Now I will declare the truth unto thee. Behold, three kings shall arise in Persia; and the fourth shall be far richer than them all; and by his strength, through his riches, he shall stir up all against the realm of Greece."
"And a mighty king shall arise; and he shall rule with great dominion, and do according to his will."

"And when he shall arise, his kingdom shall be broken, and shall be divided toward the four winds of heaven; and not to his posterity, nor according to his dominion which he ruled; for his kingdom shall be plucked up, even for others beside those."
"And in the latter time of their kingdom, when the transgressors are come to the full, a king of fierce countenance, and understanding dark sentences, shall stand up."

"And through his policy also he shall cause craft to prosper in his hand; and he shall magnify himself in his heart, and by peace shall destroy many: he shall also stand up against the Prince of princes; but he shall be broken without hand."
"And the visions of the evening and the morning which were told is true: wherefore shut thou up the vision; for it shall be for many days."
"And they shall cast their idols of silver and their idols of gold, which they made for themselves, to worship, to the moles and to the bats; and he shall stand above the king of the north."
"And this shall be the king of the south; but he shall return into his own land."

"And his sons shall be stirred up, and shall assemble a multitude of great forces; and one shall certainly come and overflow, and pass through: then shall he return, and be stirred up, even to his fortress."
የአዜብም ንጉሥ ይቈጣል፤ ወጥቶም ከመስዕ ንጉሥ ጋር ይዋጋል፤ ብዙ ሕዝብንም ለሰልፍ ያቆማል፤ ሕዝቡም አልፎ በእጁ ይሰጣል።
ሕዝቡንም ይወስዳል፤ ልቡንም ያስታብያል፤ አእላፋትንም ይጥላል፤ ነገር ግን አያሸንፍም።
የመስዕም ንጉሥ ይመለሳል፥ ከቀደመውም የበለጠ ብዙ ሕዝብን ያቆማል፤ በዘመናትና በዓመታትም ፍጻሜ ከታላቅ ሠራዊትና ከብዙ ሀብት ጋር ይመጣል።
በዚያም ዘመን ብዙ ሰዎች በአዜብ ንጉሥ ላይ ይነሣሉ፤ ከሕዝብህም መካከል የዐመፅ ልጆች ራእዩን ያጸኑ ዘንድ ይነሣሉ፤ ነገር ግን ይወድቃሉ።
የመስዕም ንጉሥ ይመጣል፤ አፈርንም ይደለድላል፤ የተመሸገችንም ከተማ ይይዛል፤ የአዜብም ክንድ የተመረጡትም ሕዝብ አይቆሙም፤ ለመቋቋምም ኀይል የላቸውም።
ወደ እርሱ የሚመጣው እንደ ፈቃዱ ያደርጋል፤ በፊቱም የሚቆም የለም፤ በመልካሚቱም ምድር ይቆማል፤ ሁሉም በእጁ ይፈጸማል።
ከመንግሥቱም ሁሉ ኀይል ጋር ይመጣ ዘንድ ፊቱን ያቀናል፤ ከእርሱም ጋር አንድነትን ያደርጋል፤ ለጥፋቱም ሴት ልጅ ትሰጠዋለች፤ እርስዋም አትጸናም፤ ለእርሱም አትሆንም።
ከዚህም በኋላ ፊቱን ወደ ደሴቶች ይመልሳል፤ ብዙዎችንም ይወስዳል፤ የኀፍረት አለቆቹንም ይሽራል፤ ኀፍረቱም በላዩ ይመለሳል።
ፊቱንም ወደ ገዛ ምድሩ አንባዎች ይመልሳል፤ ደክሞም ይወድቃል፤ አይገኝምም።
“የመንግሥትን ሥልጣንና ክብር የሚሽር ይነሣል፤ በመንበሩም ይቀመጣል፤ ነገር ግን በቍጣም ሳይሆን፥ በጦርነትም ሳይሆን ከጥቂት ቀን በኋላ ይሰበራል።

sections.title: The king of Syria, Jechaziel.

verses.text: In His place, a defiled man shall rise; they shall not give honor to the kingdom; he shall come in disgrace; and he shall hold the kingdom in contempt.
The adversaries who contend shall be broken before him; he and the leader of the covenant shall also be broken.
And with him, after being favored, he shall perform deceit; and he shall be strengthened with a small people.

In disgrace, he shall go from all the lands to the land of his desire; he shall do what his fathers and the fathers of his fathers did not do; he shall plunder and take their wealth among them; and upon the strongholds, even until the time, he shall create a desolation.

And as a great army, he shall lift his strength and heart against the king of the north; and the king of the north shall be strengthened by a great and numerous army; yet, in his thoughts, desolation shall be created against him, and he shall not stand.
Those who eat shall be gathered; and the army shall be defeated; many shall fall and perish.
And these two kings shall act wickedly in their hearts; they shall sit at one table and speak lies; yet the time has not come, and they shall not be established.
"With much wealth, he shall return to the land; his heart shall be upon the sacred covenant; he shall do his will, and he shall return to his native land."
At the appointed time, he shall return; and he shall come to the north; yet, the latter shall not be as the former.

Behold, they shall come upon him, and he shall be grieved; therefore, he shall return, and he shall be angry against the holy covenant; he shall do his will; and he shall return to regard those who have forsaken the holy covenant.
The young men shall rise up against him; they shall defile the house of the sanctuary; they shall offer the sacrifices of the season; and they shall put away the abomination of desolation.
They who despise the covenant shall be led astray by the night; but the people who know their God shall be strong and do exploits.
Among the wise men of the people, many shall instruct others; yet they shall be slain by sword and by fire, and in captivity and for many days they shall suffer.
In the time of trouble, they shall help with little aid; and many shall join themselves to them in hypocrisy.

The time has not yet come; therefore, let them be troubled, let them be distressed and let them be tormented until the time comes; for until then, the afflicted shall endure tribulation; let the one who stands in a holy place, and reads the book, take this to heart.

"The king shall do according to his will; he shall exalt himself, and magnify himself above every god; and against the God of gods shall he speak marvelous things; and he shall prosper until the indignation be accomplished; for that which is determined shall be done."
He regards not the God of his fathers, nor the desire of women; for he shall magnify himself above all, and shall not regard any god.
He shall be strong in the power of God; and the God whom his fathers knew not shall he honor with gold and silver, and with precious stones and pleasant things.
He shall do great things with the strongholds of the gods; he shall increase their glory; he shall cause them to rule over many; and he shall divide the land for gain.

"In the time of the end, the king of the south shall push at him; and the king of the north shall come against him like a whirlwind, with chariots, and with horsemen, and with many ships; and he shall enter into the countries, and shall overflow and pass over."
ወደ መልካሚቱም ምድር ይገባል፤ ብዙ ሀገሮችም ይወድቃሉ፤ ነገር ግን ኤዶምያስና ሞዓብ፥ ከአሞንም ልጆች የበለጡት ከእጁ ይድናሉ።
እጁን በሀገሮች ላይ ይዘረጋል፤ የግብፅም ምድር ከእጁ አታመልጥም።
በወርቅና በብርም መዝገብ ላይ ፥ በከበረችም በግብፅ ዕቃ ሁሉ ላይ ይሠለጥናል፤ የሊብያና የኢትዮጵያ ሰዎችም ረዳቶች ይሆኑታል።
ከምሥራቅና ከሰሜን ግን ወሬ ይደርሰዋል፤ ይቸኩላልም፤ ብዙ ሰዎችንም ይገድልና ፈጽሞ ያጠፋ ዘንድ በታላቅ ቍጣ ይወጣል።
ንጉሣዊ ድንኳኑንም በባሕርና በከበረው በቅዱሱ ተራራ መካከል ይተክላል፤ እስከ ጊዜውም ይበረታል። የሚረዳውም የለም።

sections.title: The End of the World

verses.text: "And in that time, the great leader Michael shall arise for your people; and there shall be a time of trouble, such as has not been since there was a nation, even to that time. But at that time, your people shall be delivered, every one who is found written in the book."
"And many of those who sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt."
"And those who are wise shall shine like the brightness of the heavens, and those who lead many to righteousness, like the stars for ever and ever."
"But you, Daniel, shut up the words and seal the book until the time of the end; many shall run to and fro, and knowledge shall increase."
"And I, Daniel, looked; and there stood two others, one on this side of the bank of the river, and the other on that side of the bank of the river."
"And one said to the man clothed in linen, who was above the waters of the river, 'How long shall it be till the end of these wonders?'"

"And I heard the man clothed in linen, who was above the waters of the river, when he held up his right hand and his left hand toward heaven, and swore by Him who lives forever that it shall be for a time, times, and half a time; and when the shattering of the power of the holy people comes to an end, all these things shall be finished."
"And I heard, but I did not understand. Then I said, 'O my Lord, what shall be the outcome of these things?'"
"And he said, 'Go your way, Daniel, for the words are shut up and sealed until the time of the end.'"
"And many shall purify themselves and make themselves white and be refined, but the wicked shall act wickedly, and none of the wicked shall understand; but those who are wise shall understand."
ለጥፋት ርኵሰት ለመስጠት የዘወትሩ መሥዋዕት ከቀረ ጀምሮ፥ ሺህ ሁለት መቶ ዘጠና ቀን ይሆናል።
የሚታገሥ፥ እስከ ሺህ ሦስት መቶ ሠላሳ አምስት ቀንም የሚደርስ ምስጉን ነው።
አንተ ግን ሂድና እረፍ፤ ለፍጻሜው ገና ቀንና ዘመን አለ፤ በቀኑም መጨረሻ ትነሣለህ፤ በዕጣ ክፍልህም ትቆማለህ።”

sections.title: Three

verses.text: In Babylon there was a man whose name was Jehoiakim.
His wife was named Susanna, the daughter of Hilkiah; she was very beautiful and feared the Lord greatly.
And her parents were righteous people; they taught their daughter the law of Moses.
Jehoiakim was exceedingly wealthy; he had a garden near his house, and all revered him, and many people came to him.
They said, "Let us keep the people of Babylon in sin," and the teachers of the law, as it is written, spoke concerning them two teachers who were seen among the people during that time.
They served in the house of Jehoiakim, and all who were in need came to him.
When all the people entered their houses, at the time of evening, Susanna would walk in her husband's garden.
And those two teachers, as she walked, would always watch her; they desired her.
And they turned their hearts to her; they did not see the heavens, nor did they remember the true judgment.
Both of them were inflamed with lust; they did not speak to each other of the matter that was in their hearts.
Their desire was spoken of, for they sought to lie with her.
And that which she had found, they were to keep at all times.
One said to the other, "It is the time of the evening, let us go into our house."

And they went away, each one to his own place. They returned and gathered together in unity; both of them saw one another, and at that time they spoke of their desire. They also sought the time when they might find her alone.
After this, when the day came to keep watch, she entered with her two guards, for it was not fitting that she should be without them, and she went to bathe in a secluded place.
And no one was there except for those two teachers who were keeping watch.
They commanded that the guards should bring her oil and perfume, and that the door of the secluded place should be shut.

And they did as they were commanded; they shut the door of the secluded place and brought that which they had commanded, and they went out to the street. But those teachers who had been watching did not see them.
And after those guards had gone out, the two teachers arose and ran to her.
"Behold, the door of the secluded place is shut; there is no one to see us. Let us lie with you, for we are in love with you."
"This is not the case; however, let us speak as if we have found a man with you, and we shall be led astray. Therefore, she said, 'You have driven away your guards from me and have cast me out.'"
"And she cried out thrice, 'In all my distress, I have been troubled; if I act, I shall die; if I do not act, I shall not live; I cannot even escape their grasp.'"
"In the presence of the Lord, it is better for me to fall by your hand than to commit sin," she said.
"And she cried out thrice, and those teachers also cried out with her."
"And one of them broke open the door where we had been confined."
"And those who were in her house, hearing the cry from the place of confinement, went out; and they saw that it was as if they had fled through the narrow street."
"And when these two teachers spoke of this matter, it was so that when the thrice spoken word was heard, it was not known at all, and her generations and her servants were greatly troubled."
"And in the midst of the gathering, the people were gathered together under Jehoiakim, and at that time those two teachers were brought to the three, and they came with their hearts troubled."
"They said, 'Let it be brought before all the people, and send to Jehoiakim's wife and to the three,' and they sent to her."
"And she came with her mother and her father, with her children and all her generations."
And the three were exceedingly sorrowful, and her countenance was fair.
And those teachers commanded that they should reveal their secrets, that they might be hidden from the people; and they revealed their secrets.
Her father and her mother, and all her household, and all the people who knew her, were mourning for her.
And those two teachers arose among the people and laid their hands upon her.
But she, her heart trusted in the Lord, and as she was mourning, she looked toward heaven.
And those teachers said, "When we return to the place of the altar, this woman entered with her two companions; and her companions have gone away, and they went out through the door of the altar."
And after they had sent away her companions, a certain man came to her and lay with her.
And we also, having become a door at that altar, did not see their sins; and we ran to them; and in unity we lay down and found them.
And we also took hold of him; he strengthened us and we were comforted; and the door of the altar was opened and he went out.
But she held him; and the man asked, "Who is he?" But she did not tell us; and concerning this matter, we are witnesses."
For the people had teachers, and there were those who were afraid, and the gathered multitude in the assembly believed their words; they commanded that they should be put to death.
And they cried out with a loud voice, saying, “O God, who art eternal, who knowest what is hidden, who knowest all things before they come to be!”
“As thou knowest that I am falsely accused, for these teachers have done me wrong without cause, behold, I am about to die,” she said.
And the Lord heard their words.
And it was that when he was taken, the Lord stirred the heart of a young man named Daniel.
And he said, “I am pure blood from this woman,” and he spoke his words with conviction.
And all the people turned to him, saying, “What is this matter that thou speakest?”

And Daniel stood in their midst and said, “Ye who are the elders of the children of Israel! Do not condemn without examination, nor judge without hearing; how can ye thus condemn the daughter of Israel?”
“These teachers have falsely accused her, therefore return to the assembly,” they said.
And all the people ran back to the assembly; and the leaders said to Daniel, “O God, thou hast not forsaken us; remain among us and speak to us.”
Daniel said, “You have brought forth your own destruction; I too shall inquire of them.”
They each brought forth their own destruction; and he, calling one, said, “You have been cast down by wickedness; your former sins have reached you.”
“For you have delivered a false judgment, and do not oppress the righteous and the innocent,” thus saith the Lord God, “but you have condemned the wicked.”
“Now, did you see this woman playing under what kind of tree? Tell me,” he said. “I saw them playing under a fig tree,” she replied.
Daniel said, “Truly you have spoken falsely; your blood is upon your own head; the angel of the Lord shall come forth from among you to judge you, behold, you are condemned by the Lord.”

He also caused her to sleep; and he commanded that the second one be brought forth; and they brought her forth, saying, “You are not of the lineage of Judah, but of the lineage of Canaan; your beauty has deceived you, and wicked desire has ensnared your heart.”
“She could not harm you, for a woman of Judah has delivered you, and she shall save your life; and your sins shall be upon her, for thus shall a daughter of Israel treat you.”
“Now, while they were playing, what kind of tree did you see?” he asked. And he answered, “I saw them under a tree called a Roman.”
Daniel said, “You too have spoken falsely; your blood is upon your own head; by the sword you shall be judged, and behold, the angel of the Lord shall keep watch over you.”
And all the people raised their voices and cried out; they believed in her, and they praised the Lord God who had delivered them.
And Daniel arose from his words, for they had borne false witness against him; and they rose up against him in enmity, concerning the two teachers.
Even as Moses had done, so they did unto their adversaries; they also condemned them; and on that day they shed innocent blood.
No evil deed was found upon her, and for her children, for Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, and for her husband Jehoiakim, she gave thanks unto the Lord with all her days.
And from that day forth, Daniel was ever in the presence of the Lord and before the people.

sections.title: Chapter 14
Daniel and the Priests of Bel

verses.text: ንጉሡ አስጢያጊስም ሞቶ በአባቶቹ መቃብር ከተቀበረ በኋላ የፋርሱ ንጉሥ ቂሮስ መንግሥቱን ያዘ።
ዳንኤልም የንጉሡ እልፍኝ አሽከር ነበረ፤ ከጓደኞቹም ሁሉ እርሱ ይከብር ነበር።
የባቢሎን ሰዎች የሚያመልኩት ስሙ ቤል የሚባል ጣዖት ነበር፤ ምግቡንም ሁልጊዜ ዐሥራ ሁለት ጫን በሚፈጅ ቻል ዐሥራ ሁለት መስፈሪያ ስንዴ፥ አርባ በግ፥ ስድስት ፊቀንም ወይን እያውጣጡ ይሰጡት ነበር።
ንጉሡም ያመልከው ነበር፤ ሁልጊዜም ወደ እርሱ እየሄደ ይሰግድለት ነበር፤ ዳንኤል ግን ለፈጣሪው ይሰግድ ነበር። ንጉሡም ዳንኤልን፥ “ለቤል የማትሰግድ ለምንድን ነው?” አለው።
ዳንኤልም ንጉሡን፥ “እኔስ ሰማይንና ምድርን የፈጠረ፥ ፍጥረትን ሁሉ የሚገዛ ሕያው አምላክን አመልካለሁ እንጂ የሰው እጅ የሠራው ጣዖትን አላመልክም” አለው።
ንጉሡም፥ “ቤል ሕያው ያልሆነ አምላክ ይመስልሃልን? በየቀኑ እንደሚበላና እንደሚጠጣ አታይምን?” አለው።
ዳንኤልም ሳቀና፥ “ንጉሥ ሆይ! አያስቱህ፤ ይህስ ውስጡ ጭቃ፥ ላዩም ናስ ነው፤ ፈጽሞም አይበላም፥ አይጠጣምም” አለው።
ንጉሡም ተቈጣ፤ የቤልን ካህናት ጠርቶ፥ “ይህን የቤልን ምግብ ማን እንደሚበላው ካልነገራችሁኝ ትሞታላችሁ።
ቤል እንደሚበላ ብታረጋግጡልኝ ግን ቤልን የፀረፈ ዳንኤል ይሞታል” አላቸው። ዳንኤልም ንጉሡን፥ “እንዳልኸው ይሁን” አለው።
ከሴቶቻቸውና ከልጆቻቸው በቀር የቤል ካህናት ሰባ ይሆኑ ነበር፤ ዳንኤልና ንጉሡም ወደ ቤል ቤት ሄዱ።

And the priests of Baal said, "Behold, we shall go forth; O king! You also prepare the temple; and let your servants make ready the offerings; and do not let anything be lacking in your preparations."
"If Baal should find us, we shall surely die; but if he does not find us, then Daniel, who has spoken falsehood against us, shall die," they said.
Yet they knew what they were doing; for there was a secret entrance beneath the temple; and always they would enter there to eat.

And after they had gone out, the king prepared that which was to be offered to Baal; and Daniel commanded that the food be brought in, that it might be set before the king; and in the presence of the king, all was made ready in the house.
And after they had departed, the priests of Baal, as was their custom, entered by night with their children and their wives, and they did eat all.
And the king and Daniel went forth in the morning.
And the king said to Daniel, "Is the food well?" And Daniel said, "O king, it is well."
And after this, when the food was set before him, the king found the temple as it had been; and with a great voice he cried out, "O Baal! You are great; there is no deceit in you."
And Daniel said, "You have deceived the king; and he has been led astray; and he said, 'Look upon the earth; see what you seek; what is this that we seek?'"
And the king said, "I do not seek the offerings of men or women, nor the offerings of children." And the king was angry.

And at that time, the priests of Baal took their wives and their children, and they entered into the temple, that they might eat and drink, and they showed them the gate of the inner chamber that was prepared.
Therefore the king commanded them to be slain, and he gave Baal to Daniel; and Daniel destroyed him, and he also cast down his house.

sections.title: Daniel was cast into the den.

verses.text: በዚያም ስፍራ የባቢሎን ሰዎች የሚያመልኩት ታላቅ ዘንዶ ነበር።
ንጉሡም ዳንኤልን፥ “ይህንም ናስ ነው ትለዋለህን? እነሆ ሕያው ነው፤ ይበላል፤ ይጠጣልም፤ ሕያው አምላክ አይደለም ትለው ዘንድ አትችልም፤ ስለዚህ ስገድለት” አለው።
ዳንኤልም “ለፈጣሪዬ ለእግዚአብሔር እሰግዳለሁ፤ እርሱ ሕያው አምላክ ነውና።
ንጉሥ ሆይ! ይህን ዘንዶ ያለ ሰይፍና ያለ በትር እገድለው ዘንድ ፍቀድልኝ” አለው፤ ንጉሡም ዳንኤልን፥ “ፈቅጀልሃለሁ” አለው።
ዳንኤልም አደሮማርና ጠጕር ስብም አምጥቶ በአንድነት ቀቀለው፤ ልህሉህም አደረገው፤ ለዘንዶውም በአፉ አጐረሰው፤ ዘንዶውም በጐረሰው ጊዜ ተሰንጥቆ ሞተ፤ ዳንኤልም፥ “አምላካችሁን እዩ” አላቸው።
ከዚህ በኋላ የባቢሎን ሰዎች በሰሙ ጊዜ እጅግ ተቈጡ፤ በንጉሡም ላይ ተነሡ፤ እንዲህም አሉ፥ “ንጉሥ ይሁዳዊ ሆነ፤ ቤልን ሰበረ፤ ካህናቱንም አረደ፤ ዘንዶውንም ገደለ።”
ወደ ንጉሡም ሄዱ፤ እንዲህም አሉት፥ “ዳንኤልን ስጠን። ይህ ካልሆነ ግን ገንዘብህን እንዘርፋለን፤ እንገድልሃለን፤ ቤትህንም በእሳት እናቃጥላለን” አሉት።
ንጉሡም እጅግ እንዳስጨነቁት በአየ ጊዜ፥ ለንጉሡም ግዴታ በሆነበት ጊዜ ዳንኤልን አሳልፎ ሰጣቸው።
እነርሱም ወደ አንበሶች ጕድጓድ ጣሉት፤ በዚያም ስድስት ቀን ተቀመጠ።
በዚያም ሰባት አንበሶች ነበሩ። በየቀኑም ሁለት ሰውና ሁለት በግ ይመግቧቸው ነበር፤ ያንጊዜ ግን ዳንኤልን እንዲበሉት ምንም አልሰጧቸውም ነበር።
The prophet was in Babylon; he had set aside the spirit of Egypt; and he had prepared bread, and he went to the field, holding it for those who were in need.
And the angel of the Lord said to Daniel, "Take this food to Daniel, who is in Babylon, to the den of lions."
And Daniel said, "O my Lord! I have not seen Babylon; nor do I know where the den of lions is."
And the angel of the Lord, carried by the Spirit of the Holy, arrived in Babylon and came to the den of lions.
And the angel cried out, saying, "Daniel! Daniel! Receive this food that the Lord has sent to you."
And Daniel said, "Is it not the Lord who has thought of me, that my friends may not perish?"
And Daniel arose and ate; and the angel of the Lord returned to his place.
And the king came on the seventh day and spoke to Daniel; and when he approached the den of lions, he saw Daniel sitting among the lions.
And the king cried out with a loud voice, saying, "O God of Daniel! You are great; there is no other god besides You."
And they brought Daniel out from the den of lions. They sought to destroy him, but those who had conspired against him were thrown into the den of lions, and the lions immediately devoured them.
